summary: All supplied candidate utility arithmetic, action identities, aggregate claims and archived execution bindings pass. The evidence establishes fixed training-state executed-query opportunity only.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Dataset init.txt boxes enter through the hash-bound manifest. Train882/dev97 order and train/dev/test245 disjointness match repository lists. All ordered 1752 states belong to the planned 20 training sequences. Frame0 GT initializes the template; valid-frame GT metadata selects evaluation eligibility. Current-frame coordinates are materialized after proposal/region construction and never flow into candidate generation, query pixels, query readout or the advancing primary-only tracker. Actual GT IoU/coverage labels are checked against uncensored manifest boxes. Original remote init.txt and image pixels were not recaptured.

B_score_normalization.details: IoU uses intersection/union and coverage uses target area. Signed benefit is query IoU minus primary IoU. No metric divides by the maximum/mean of this model's predictions. Cosine normalization, gain-head entropy features and Gaussian training weights are model/training computations, not result normalization. max(gain,0) is explicitly GT-dependent STOP selection, reported separately from forced-query signed gain.

C_result_existence_and_numbers.details: Native COMPLETE/exit0, exact launch commands, raw config/COMPLETE/SANITY copies, 17 preserved transport receipts, private CSV and CPU/choice outputs exist and bind by hash. All 31384 formal rows and 36 M0 rows recompute with exact zero errors. All 24 scope/prefix/action aggregate groups and 24 magnitude summaries reproduce. Published rounded means, signs, positive counts, IoU threshold counts and substantial-gain counts agree. The first 36 formal rows exactly reproduce M0. Earlier explicitly timestamped pending claims are historical records, not current false completion claims.

D_metric_execution.details: The producer invokes pixel_iou and region_coverage on each executed query and aggregate on the stored rows. Its output is the actual native COMPLETE. The actual CPU invocation called clip/IoU/coverage recomputation and summary code, and the actual choice invocation called summarize for fixed and best-prefix actions; stdout content binds to the reports. The present reviewer separately recomputed their values without importing torch or project neural code. Official PR/NPR/SR functions were not run by this diagnostic and no such result is credited.

E_scope_and_claim_ceiling.details: One seed (2027), one fitted preview/checkpoint pair, 20 training sequences, 8854 primary-only tracking steps and 1752 every-fifth valid label states; 239 main-centre-outside states. Statistics weight states, not sequences; states are correlated and in the training split. Best-prefix actions, coverage choice and STOP inclusion use GT. Same-family one-query resolution/tokens are fixed, but all counterfactuals were executed to diagnose them. This is no learned selector, closed-loop trajectory bound, held-out generalization result, complete LasHeR score, speed measurement, causal mechanism proof or project-target certification.

F_evaluation_classification.details: The advancing trajectory comes from model predictions, but annotations remain dataset GT. GT-conditioned post-hoc action choice is an oracle diagnosis, not synthetic/model-generated target evaluation. Both legacy GT-centred intervention regions and the present proposal pool are distinct experiment conditions; legacy content effects cannot be transplanted to new proposals.

findings.title: Complete candidate/action reconstruction and exact executed-box arithmetic
findings.details: Stable score-order reconstruction reproduces 1752 lists, 13940 indices/points and all 14016 prefix/family geometry records. Histogram 2:2, 3:7, 4:1, 5:4, 6:4, 7:5, 8:1729; all 23 short lists exhaust valid cells. All global query geometry and all 3504 legacy local geometries/executed boxes/IoUs reproduce. Main-outside membership is now independently recomputed from saved main geometry, rather than only inherited from the predecessor.

findings.title: Separate models, actual M0 gate and exact eight-field reload
findings.details: Both native tasks completed with exit0 under the sealed repaired driver. Separate strict reference/fitted loads require exactly six preview changes and 259 shared equal tensors; both 265-entry states are checked unchanged with absent gradients after execution. M0 recorded two states/36 queries plus two reload query probes, exact five query plus three candidate fields, and bit equality. Formal command/config names the exact M0 COMPLETE digest before constructing models. The metadata gate itself tests eight-field length; the actual producer and captured SANITY/collector establish exact field names. The driver does not rehash sanity CSV itself; the actual collector verifies its hash, all raw metadata hashes match, and formal reproduces its first 36 rows. No invented generic strengthening is required to accept these actual artifacts.

findings.title: R1 failure and CPU arithmetic failure remain preserved
findings.details: Undoing exactly two candidate-role complements byte-reconstructs archived R1; the plan changes only that source hash and R2 path. Query calls correctly keep the primary role, while the reader complements internally. The old CPU analyzer differs by one scalar-conversion line, with the sanity checker unchanged. Independently rerunning the old arithmetic on actual M0 boxes yields 3.0517578125e-05 maximum clipping discrepancy, exceeding its unchanged 1e-5 threshold. Python-float clipping before the float32 cast yields exactly zero error on both saved runs. Original exit1 tool receipt and corrected exit0 receipt are preserved; no NN rerun or tolerance relaxation is inferred.

findings.title: Oracle opportunity is supported; selector effectiveness and deployment cost remain unknown
findings.details: Outside states have zero primary IoU. Local Top1/best8 mean IoU is 0.0337360558/0.2301839757; wide is 0.0408293935/0.3377776673. Wide best8 has 129 gains >=0.01,125 >=0.05,123 >=0.1. Yet all-state forced best8 signed means are negative for both global families. GT-dependent STOP and choice are essential to the displayed opportunities. Highest-GT-coverage wide choice yields 0.2347693618, below highest-executed-IoU choice 0.3377776673. This supports an imperfect geometric proxy on these states; it identifies no error cause or learnable feature sufficiency. A future variable-candidate selector is still unimplemented and uncertified.

findings.title: Local CPU verification does not reload original remote annotations or checkpoints
findings.details: Seven of ten plan inputs were rehashed as actual local bytes. The three checkpoint inputs and protected CAD checkpoint are bound by predecessor/native execution records and required start/end/runtime assertions, without local tensor loading. No remote init.txt/image bytes were recaptured and no independent NN rerun was permitted. Transport consistency and arithmetic acceptance are deterministic; semantic integrity remains same-family/provisional, requested Astra/max with actual routing UNATTESTED.

findings.title: Preserve the old pending snapshots and distinguish observation time
findings.details: The 20:50 admission snapshot and pre-execution R2 statements remain historical; they were not silently rewritten by this audit. HANDOFF line22's 20:38:20.832287 is the M0 collection/observation time, while native M0 completion is 20:35:37.490006 BJT. Formal native completion is 21:21:03.994471 BJT, followed by collection. This timestamp distinction does not change the exit0 or metric findings.
